preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100.
Number of magnets is between 3 and 2000.
Total number of magnets across all test cases does not exceed 2000.
The sum of magnets on the left and right parts does not exceed the total number of magnets.
Both l and r are between 1 and n-1.
All indices in a and b are unique.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All indices in a are within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= n for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: All indices in b are within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i != b_j for a_i in a for b_j in b)
preconditions.description: No magnet is placed on both sides in the same query.

postconditions.description: The absolute value of the force is less than or equal to the number of magnets.
The force is calculated correctly based on the number of N and S magnets on both sides.

postconditions.expression: len(A) > 0 and all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in A)
postconditions.description: The reported demagnetized magnets are within the valid range.
